request: Implement F07-T05-T06: write delete-bookmark.test.js and restore-bookmark.test.js, then run the build-verify loop.
response: Wrote both test files. First npx vitest run showed 17 failures across both files, each showing the exact expected AppError thrown at the exact expected line. Diagnosed as a test-authoring bug: softDelete/restore are synchronous functions (matching list()'s shape), so expect(service.softDelete(id)).rejects.toMatchObject(...) lets the sync throw escape while evaluating expect()'s argument, before .rejects can attach. Fixed by replacing every such assertion with a captureError(() => ...) helper, and fixed an unrelated liveRows() bug (it selected all rows, not just WHERE deleted_at IS NULL). Second npx vitest run: 503/503 passed, 0 failed. prettier/eslint clean on both attempts. Logged E-build-702 with TODO(human) fields.

request: Implement F07-T08-T09: generalize BookmarksStore's toast into showToast/clearToast/toastUndo, and add deleteBookmark(item)/restoreBookmark(id), then run the build-verify loop.
